021import com.google.common.io.ByteArrayDataOutput;
022import net.tnemc.core.config.DataConfig;
023import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
024import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.channel.ChannelBytesWrapper;
025import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.log.DebugLevel;
026
027import java.io.IOException;
028
029/**
030 * Shared security helpers for proxy sync messages.
031 *
032 * @author creatorfromhell
033 * @since 0.1.4.3
034 */
035public final class ChannelSecurity {
036
037  private static final String DEFAULT_TOKEN = "CHANGE_ME";
038  private static boolean warnedInvalidConfig = false;
039
040  private ChannelSecurity() {
041  }
042
043  public static void writeToken(final ByteArrayDataOutput out) {
044
045    out.writeUTF(token());
046  }
047
048  public static boolean validate(final ChannelBytesWrapper wrapper, final String type) {
049
050    final String expected = token();
051    if(!isConfigured(expected)) {
052      warnInvalidConfig();
053      return false;
054    }
055
056    final String provided;
057    try {
058      provided = wrapper.readUTF();
059    } catch(final IOException e) {
060      PluginCore.log().error("Rejected " + type + " sync payload due to malformed security token.", e, DebugLevel.STANDARD);
061      return false;
062    }
063
064    if(expected.equals(provided)) {
065      return true;
066    }
067
068    PluginCore.log().error("Rejected " + type + " sync payload due to invalid security token.", DebugLevel.STANDARD);
069    return false;
070  }
071
072  public static String token() {
073
074    final String configured = DataConfig.yaml().getString("Data.Sync.Security.Token", "");
075    if(configured == null) {
076      return "";
077    }
078    return configured.trim();
079  }
080
081  public static boolean configured() {
082
083    return isConfigured(token());
084  }
085
086  private static boolean isConfigured(final String token) {
087
088    return !token.isEmpty()
089           && !token.equalsIgnoreCase("none")
090           && !token.equalsIgnoreCase(DEFAULT_TOKEN);
091  }
092
093  private static void warnInvalidConfig() {
094
095    if(warnedInvalidConfig) {
096      return;
097    }
098
099    PluginCore.log().error("Data.Sync.Security.Token must be configured to a non-default value before cross-server sync is accepted.",
100                           DebugLevel.OFF);
101    warnedInvalidConfig = true;
102  }
103}
